Resume, accessibility and 12 languages

Smaller things that make Sunmeld easier to pick up: saved games, accessibility and language support.

Some changes are not about rules. This note covers three that make Sunmeld easier to pick up. The game is still in development for iOS and Android.

Pick up where you left off

A saved game can be resumed right where you left off, so a phone call or a lock screen does not cost you a round.

Accessibility

The game has screen reader labels and supports larger text. We check that screens still fit at small sizes and with larger text.

12 languages

The new screens are available in 12 languages. We wrote the translations ourselves and have not had every language reviewed by a native speaker, so wording may still change.

What is next

We will keep going through screens for fit and clarity. There is no release date yet.

FAQ

Can I resume a saved game?

Yes. A saved game resumes right where you left off.

Does Sunmeld support accessibility?

It has screen reader labels and supports larger text.

Which languages does Sunmeld support?

The new screens are in 12 languages. Not every language has been reviewed by a native speaker yet, so wording may change.
